scope: AIC Markdown functionality implemented by standard-notes-aic and aic-notes

status.currentFacts: Entrypoints and verification paths describe the current working trees. The aic-notes/vendor copies are distribution artifacts and are not independent feature owners.
status.approvedDirection: Maintain one stable registry of user-visible features, shared runtime capabilities, and host adapters.
status.reviewPending: Reviewers must confirm feature boundaries and close the declared coverage gaps before treating this registry as exhaustive.

hosts.shared-core: Canonical reusable editor behavior owned by standard-notes-aic/src/core
hosts.pwa: Device-local portable file and folder Notes app

coveragePolicy: Every canonical src .ts/.js/.css file and every aic-notes src or vendor/markdown .js/.css adapter file must appear in at least one feature sourceFiles array. Distributed aic-notes/vendor/aic-editor-core copies are excluded because their canonical owners are standard-notes-aic/src/core.

features.purpose: The PWA is one note. On first run the user opens an existing Markdown file or creates a new one (suggested name aic.md); every launch reopens that file. Where the browser can write files (File System Access), the note is bound to that one file handle: saves write the file by compare-and-swap against the text last read, a change made elsewhere (outside the app or in another window) keeps the draft and offers Reload note file, typing that is not yet saved is also kept in the browser until saved and offered again after a closed page, a moved or deleted file is never recreated, and while access must be granted again the last copy stored in the browser is shown read-only with one Reconnect note file action. Other browsers keep the note in IndexedDB with Download note and Replace from file. The whole note is shown as page cards; Open target opens URL targets in a new tab and is not offered for file paths. Workspaces, folder import, the file tree and new-file creation were removed; earlier workspace data stays in the browser, unused. No application encryption is provided. Update activation waits for acknowledged saves.

Use browser-owned local inference to fix grammar or improve selected prose, protecting code, links, properties and secret fences. Apply a reviewed suggestion as one undoable edit only while the original document and selection remain current.

Publish bilingual terms, the existing privacy policy, release history, installation instructions and a document-authoring How to at aic.dzyha.com. Serve the offline documents at clean URLs and repair redirected HTML in previous shell caches without changing note storage or forcing app-update activation.

Verify exact release packages before browser or VS Code marketplace submission, and propose reviewed updates of the canonical editor core with real commit provenance. Store and repository access must be configured before activation.
Compose CodeMirror, document switching, host save callbacks, access state, theme refresh, and teardown.
Provide Markdown parsing, nested fenced-language support, syntax highlighting, and reveal decorations.

Render headings, smaller italic and quote text, softly shaded quote blocks with a side rule, short centered horizontal rules, lists, links, code fences, and other structured Markdown previews with readable spacing without replacing source truth. Code previews retain full content height and independent horizontal scrolling while vertical wheel and touch gestures chain to the document, including previews inside details.

Provide one always-compact Standard Notes/browser toolbar with direct strike, link, bullet, ordered and task-list actions while keyboard, Markdown and slash commands own the omitted formatting operations; also preserve list continuation, indentation and one-operation undo boundaries.
Render and toggle Markdown task checkboxes with keyboard, read-only, stale-control, and ARIA safeguards.
Open or copy safe external links and route verified local links through the owning host. VS Code resolves workspace-contained links and opens a valid `#Lx` or `#Lx-Ly` line range in the target file.
Render language-aware fenced-code cards with copy/edit/cut controls while preserving unsupported source. Cut copies the complete Markdown block before removing it.
Render tables, copy or cut the complete Markdown block, insert and reorder rows or columns, and edit one cell through a bounded popover.

Parse and render details accordions with readable wrapping titles, consistent source actions, and inset nested previews inside a continuous parent boundary while retaining whole-block cut, links, tasks, comments, and open state.

Parse and render independently typed pipe values, including explicit one-time states, inside the single bounded aic document while preserving retired YAML Properties as raw Markdown without conversion.

Parse and render bounded AIC credential blocks with masking, independently scoped field/section/block copy, whole-block cut, add, delete, filtering, diagnostics, responsive whole-item wrapping, and exact-source reordering. Labels and typed values use natural width and wrap as complete items before text breaks; passwords use compact lock-only copy targets, short card/TOTP values stay intact, and creation controls continue the final value. Larger section headings, neutral group backgrounds and subtle alternating gray row surfaces distinguish the hierarchy. Icon-only password, section and block copy targets show temporary success checkmarks or failure crosses while keeping stable accessible action names and live feedback. Leaving block source edit or whole-note source mode stably sorts labelled rows in natural case-insensitive order within each section, with unlabelled rows last; exact authored rows, value order and section order are preserved. Section copy preserves type and masking markers. Cut removes source only after clipboard success.

Handle card parts, password generation for every empty editable secret part regardless of label or width, with responsive options and read-only guards, TOTP derivation, QR parsing, and recovery-code state under explicit security limits.
Convert recognized Authenticator JSON into bounded security blocks as an explicit undoable draft action with host save acknowledgement.

Edit Mermaid as source with a live preview, copy or cut the complete fence, intrinsic-size previews that shrink to fit with full content height and no internal scrolling, cancellation, and stale-result isolation.
Offer grouped slash templates and placeholder navigation for the AIC block, Markdown blocks, DDK sections and Mermaid diagrams.

Show one note as page cards: a blank-line separated `---` line starts a page and `--- <path-or-url>` binds the following page to a navigation target. A page matches a target only when their normalized forms are equal; the first match wins. Pages are a derived view; the note stays one file. In preview each separator line is a card header that names the target and offers one host action, Open target; a selection on the line shows its source, and whole-note source mode shows plain text. A host can focus one target: only that page is shown, user edits are confined to it, and a target without a page shows an empty card that is appended to the note on first typing. Path targets are compared literally after trimming, NFC, `\` as `/`, dropping a trailing `/` and lower-casing; a leading `/` or `./` is kept, so hosts write a path target exactly one way (VS Code: project-relative, e.g. `src/index.js`). The PWA and Standard Notes show the whole note as cards; the PWA, Standard Notes and the browser panel offer Open target only for http(s) URL targets. The browser panel focuses the page of its one note file bound to exactly the active URL. VS Code Linked Note shows the project note `<folder>/<folder name>.note.md`, focused on the page bound to the active file's project-relative path; a file without a page shows an empty card and the page is appended on the first edit. Text sent by the extension host is marked as an external change so it also applies outside the focused page.
Track dirty drafts, isolate note identity, centralize explicit/focus/action saves, process exact acknowledgements, retain failures, and retire stale async work.
Recognize AIC agentic note markers and shared note-contract metadata without activating external workflows itself.

Define the shared component IDs, BEM class application, button factory with decorative SVG masks and primary action tokens, left-aligned menu rows and subtle section headings, geometry tokens, and additive migration surface used by host adapters. Indicate unsaved changes on the save button with a soft pulse and static reduced-motion accent, preserving the document background and text colors.

Build one short inert local editor guide, enabled by the shared editor by default and explicitly suppressed when the browser panel owns its trigger, while each host owns popover placement, focus, Escape handling, and disposal.
Translate Standard Notes component contexts into snapshots and guarded save targets with lock, identity, timeout, and disposal checks.
Run the editor as a development demo with plaintext localStorage persistence; it is not a credential-safe production host.

Edit one plain Markdown note file directly: the file the user opened or created (suggested name aic.md); folders are not opened. The browser worker serializes mutations and writes the whole file by compare-and-swap against the bytes it last read, so a change made elsewhere is reported as a conflict; the file is limited to 512 KiB and is never truncated. A moved or deleted note file is never recreated. No other file is listed, read or written. A folder remembered by an earlier version is not reopened; the panel asks for the note file. Draft recovery copies, including copies of earlier page, Shared and Global drafts, stay reviewable and exportable and are never applied to the note file.

Show the page of the note file bound to the active tab's URL by its `--- <url>` separator, as one focused card with Open target as its only action; a URL without a page shows an empty card and the page is appended on the first typing. Tab changes refocus the same editor without changing the document or an unsaved draft, and a change of target empties the undo history; a tab without an http(s) URL shows the whole note. A change to the file made elsewhere is taken in as an external update when the panel regains focus or the tab changes, never over an unsaved draft. File status stays unsaved through pending writes, and failed saves retain the draft. A save that finds the file changed on disk rebases the draft when only its focused page differs and that page is unchanged on disk; otherwise the conflict keeps the draft exportable and offers a confirmed discard that loads the disk text.

Capture the explicitly selected current page content or selection, sanitize it into Markdown, resolve safe links, and insert page or file content at the end of the focused page of the note, creating the page when the URL has none, after permission and navigation-race checks; inserted lines that would start another page are rewritten; native paste remains editor-owned.

Download the focused page, the whole note file, an unsaved draft or a recovered draft copy explicitly as Markdown without altering the original file. Imported Markdown uses the existing editor save owner. App-level encrypted backups and legacy conversion are removed.

Own side-panel context, trusted message boundaries, private-window consent, visibility teardown and stale async cancellation. The compact header contains More options only. Named file/folder, capture, Markdown transfer and help actions use left-aligned SVG rows. Source changes retain pending drafts; no password or Lock gate.

Register commands, views, editors and lifecycle ownership in desktop and browser extension hosts from one entrypoint. Bundle a Node-free browser host using Web Crypto, UTF-8 encoders and workspace.fs; retain TextDocument save/undo ownership and validate workspace-contained virtual URIs and provider write capability.

Host Markdown in a custom editor with UTF-16 change synchronization, stale-generation reset, undo/redo delegation, source/link routing, clipboard, and edit leases. Show the same compact file location/save status as browser and PWA, retaining the host resource URI/provider and acknowledged TextDocument save ownership.

Show the project note of the active file's workspace folder in the Secondary Side Bar, following the active file. Each workspace folder has one note at its root, `<folder>/<folder name>.note.md` (the workspace folder name in its exact case; a name that cannot be a file name falls back to the last path segment); with several folders the active file's folder chooses it. Only the page bound to the active file's project-relative path (`--- src/index.js`, `/` separators, no leading `./` or `/`) is shown; the note itself (in any letter case), a non-file tab, a file outside the workspace or no file shows the whole note. Open Note Page for Current File reveals the pane and creates nothing; the note file and the page are written by the first saved edit. Open target opens an http(s) URL externally or an existing file inside the note's folder by relative path; paths leaving the folder, folders and other schemes are refused. Drafts are flushed before navigation to another folder's note and never replaced by a file change; a failed flush keeps the shown note; saving a note deleted while shown is rejected and its draft is kept. A project note of that name from versions up to 60.x is adopted as is; other `*.note.md` files and the `<folder>/aic.md` of 61.6.5 are ordinary files, never followed, rewritten or deleted. Constrain the linked editor to the active panel height so long notes scroll inside CodeMirror and the footer remains visible.
Expose the shared slash catalog in native and untitled Markdown while disabling it in code and read-only contexts.

Expose bundled agent instructions and enable a trusted workspace handoff without executing AIC or changing global configuration. Discover and search file, folder and project .note.md sidecars for context, ready answers, decisions and previews; treat their content as evidence within instruction precedence and preserve owner-authored notes unless editing is explicitly requested.
Remove retired authentication/sync state exactly once and verify shared-core integrity, packaging contents, checksums, licenses, and release boundaries.

Bundle one agent-neutral Markdown instruction guide in every extension without requiring a separate AIC executable or config folder. Reference the current DDK writing method: establish the reader and next action, answer necessary questions by meaning, and stop at sufficient detail while preserving AIC Markdown and typed blocks. Discover and search file, folder and project .note.md sidecars for context, ready answers, decisions and previews; treat their content as evidence within instruction precedence and preserve owner-authored notes unless editing is explicitly requested.

coverageGaps: The registry is source- and test-derived, not runtime instrumentation; dynamically generated control variants may still need finer component entries.

Authenticated Standard Notes desktop/mobile behavior, live VS Code remote or virtual workspaces, Chromium store packaging, and cross-platform assistive-technology behavior are not exhaustively verified by the listed automated tests.
Build, release, provenance, license, and deployment mechanics are represented as adapter/release features but are not decomposed into every script flag or CI job.
Vendor copies under aic-notes/vendor are intentionally references to the canonical shared owner and are not independently enumerated.
